id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_110.pack|cs_: "Hendrik, please. Just a moment to talk with my son.
"Don't lose heart, whatever happens. Work with Lord Hendrik and do your duty well.
"Phew... I'm getting old. It's so dark I can't even see your face.
"So please. Next time, let me see your face properly in the sunlight.
"Obsidian, take the lady back to the fortress."
